import_rules.fresh_install: seed once transactionally on first store setup, following authentic owner enrollment
import_rules.existing_install: owner-only import preview/explicit apply; create missing SKUs only, never overwrite existing prices, VAT, records or sales without explicit acceptance
import_rules.modifier_fallback: If no safe native modifiers exist, expose add-ons/upgrades as explicitly charged sale items or defer activation with operator note; do not invent support or silently drop charges.

needs_owner_confirmation: Whether listed USD customer-facing prices include VAT, and each item tax category/rate
Whether combo upgrades apply to Burgers only or also Wraps and other items
Whether dips can repeat in Greaz Box and if other appetizers include complimentary dips
Whether add-ons apply to all products or only selected lines
Soft-drink flavors and their stock-tracking policy
Whether any other items are temporarily unavailable, beyond the dessert marked SOON
